summary: Narrow down search or listing results by adjusting a range slider to a specific value and applying the filter.
preconditions: The browser is on a page displaying a list of items (e.g., products, events, jobs).
A filter panel or section containing a range slider (such as price, rating, or salary) is visible.
steps: Locate the target range slider control on the page.
Click and drag the slider handle (or click at points along the slider track) until the associated numerical label displays the desired target value.
Click the 'Apply', 'Filter', or equivalent submission button to update the results.

variants.when: The slider is linked to a text input box
variants.do: Type the target value directly into the input box instead of dragging the slider.
Release the slider handle to let the page automatically refresh and apply the filter.

watch_for: The text label near the slider updating in real-time to reflect the current value as you drag.
A loading spinner or temporary overlay indicating the results are updating.
completion_signal: The list of results updates to reflect the filtered range, or the page URL changes to include the new filter parameters.
pitfalls: Dragging too quickly and releasing on the wrong value; use fine mouse movements or keyboard arrow keys if supported to dial in the exact number.
Forgetting to click the 'Apply' button after adjusting the slider, leaving the unfiltered results on screen.
